thig5.9:1.1: lūnakesī paṅkadharī ekasāṭī pure cariṃ | avajje vajjamatinī vajje cāvajjadassinī. || ||
thig5.9:2.1: divāvihārā nikkhamma Gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate | addasaṃ virajaṃ buddhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ. || ||
thig5.9:3.1: nihacca jānuṃ vanditvā saṃmukhā pañjali ahaṃ | ehi Bhadde ti avaca sā me ās' ūpasampadā. || ||
thig5.9:4.1: ciṇṇā Aṅgā ca Magadhā Vajjī Kāsī ca Kosalā | anaṇā paṇṇāsavassāni raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ abhuñji 'haṃ. || ||
thig5.9:5.1: puññaṃ ca pasaviṃ bahuṃ sappañño vat' āyam upāsako | yo Bhaddāya cīvaram adāsi muttāya sabbagandhehi. || ||
